placement.component: existing component directory chosen after reading the app
placement.stylesheet: app-level CSS import alongside existing global styles

controlled_props.items: Reuse existing 7 menu IDs, labels and actions. onSelect calls original handlers.
controlled_props.activeItemId: Read the existing app selection state. Do not create duplicate header state.
controlled_props.notice: Pass the current notice control with its original click handler; apply notice classes below.
controlled_props.accountActions: Pass existing guest/authenticated branch. Keep handlers, labels and visual button classes.
controlled_props.onBrandClick: Preserve existing optional brand click handler.

layout.measurements_status: implementation defaults, not user-approved exact pixels
layout.old_header_and_notice_rows: replace both with one new header; no duplicated notice row or spacer
layout.css_grid_parent: If source uses grid, update rows to the single header height and original content area.
layout.fixed_header_parent: If source uses fixed/sticky offsets, update existing offsets to same height instead of layering a new layout system.

css_notes: Use current accepted --ab-* tokens. Fallback values are R1 defaults only.
Scope header changes to .ab-header2; do not reapply the full R1 theme.
Replace old header-only active borders, pseudo-elements and notice positioning when they conflict.
Keep menu controls native buttons with original behavior. No new internal state.
Map existing active state to aria-pressed. No moving pill or new animation library.
